scope: Close remaining Energy-main uncertainty with unaliased pairwise isolation plus compound validation, then synthesize and jointly screen complete TL1-TL9 Kinetic, Energy, GP Missile, and Swarmer ladders against the current accepted defense/AUX/resource environment.

energyClosureDoctrine.Low: tactical power-conservation mode for preserving TP for defense/support or anticipated main-weapon PDS duty; low utilization in unconstrained duels is not itself a defect
energyClosureDoctrine.Standard: normal Energy operating mode and expected dominant firing mode
energyClosureDoctrine.Overload: reserved burst option that adds one persistent weapon Strain per use; routine sustained use is undesirable
energyClosureDoctrine.ForcedOverload: emergency/desperation mechanic only; normal research optimizer uses safe-only overload doctrine and does not treat beyond-limit attempts as normal DPS
energyClosureDoctrine.strainInterpretation: Strain Limit is an Energy identity/design variable representing safe burst tolerance and is explicitly swept through 1,2,3,4

energyClosureDesign.pairwiseIsolation: center + every single-factor alternative + every factor-pair alternative with all other factors held at the center; 264 candidates/TL
energyClosureDesign.compoundValidation: two distinct OA(81) strength-2 blocks over the same factors, deduplicated against the isolation design; Block B reaches Strain Limit 4
energyClosureDesign.selectionPool: union of accepted CP152 broad Energy map and CP153 tested closure candidates; no untested response-surface extrapolation
energyClosureDesign.selectionConstraint: whole-ladder intrinsic damage/ACC/range/SPEN/Strain Limit are non-regressing with TL; Standard remains normal doctrine; Overload is penalized when it becomes routine

wholeLadderSynthesis.kineticSource: accepted CP152 complete 3^5 K response surface; no new broad K sweep
wholeLadderSynthesis.energySource: accepted CP152 broad map plus CP153 closure evidence
wholeLadderSynthesis.missileSource: accepted CP151 point-scale axial family-response evidence around current centers
wholeLadderSynthesis.technologyCoherence: whole TL1-TL9 sequences are selected with non-regression and jump penalties; quiet TLs remain legal; candidates are not nine independent local winners

packageScreen.construction: one deterministic resource ensemble for every Stage-A TL x weapon-pair x scenario-stratum group

packageDeepConfirmation.selection: best screen packages while first preserving representation of all eight Energy-ladder identities
packageDeepConfirmation.purpose: full Stage-A confirmation of a small diverse Pareto-oriented four-family package set
